title: Wending Mill | Nat 20 Pixels C1E8
description:
Goblins are battering at the door of a watermill, and the people of Wending Mill are behind it.
The party is four miles away. They run.

Episode 8 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel answer Captain Rook's letter and find the hamlet of Wending Mill under attack. A race down the road, a fight in the mill yard, and smoke where there should not be smoke. Every check and attack is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen: no rerolls, no fudging.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.

short.title: The fight at the mill gate | Nat 20 Pixels
short.description: Goblins are battering a watermill's door with the villagers inside. Every attack in this fight is a real, seeded roll.
